inventory_items_sales_window.name: inventory_items_sales_window
inventory_items_sales_window.value: "inventory_items"."sales_start_at" IS NULL OR "inventory_items"."sales_end_at" IS NULL OR "inventory_items"."sales_end_at" > "inventory_items"."sales_start_at"

jobs_lease_when_running.name: jobs_lease_when_running
jobs_lease_when_running.value: "jobs"."status" <> 'running' OR ("jobs"."locked_by" IS NOT NULL AND "jobs"."locked_until" IS NOT NULL)

action_requests_decision.name: action_requests_decision
action_requests_decision.value: ("action_requests"."status" IN ('pending_approval', 'expired')) OR ("action_requests"."decided_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "action_requests"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

commercial_recommendations_experience_wh.name: commercial_recommendations_experience_when_drafted
commercial_recommendations_experience_wh.value: "commercial_recommendations"."status" NOT IN ('drafted', 'published') OR "commercial_recommendations"."experience_id" IS NOT NULL

demand_signals_shape.name: demand_signals_shape
demand_signals_shape.value:
CASE "demand_signals"."kind"
            WHEN 'search_unmatched' THEN "demand_signals"."query" IS NOT NULL AND "demand_signals"."inventory_item_id" IS NULL
            ELSE "demand_signals"."inventory_item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "demand_signals"."event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "demand_signals"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL
          END

demand_signals_query_length.name: demand_signals_query_length
demand_signals_query_length.value: "demand_signals"."query" IS NULL OR char_length("demand_signals"."query") BETWEEN 1 AND 120
